note: Every page is synthetic. No figure on these pages is a current benefit rate or threshold.

pages.title: What Housing Benefit is
retention: synthetic page, no statutory period set by this starter
pages.body: Housing Benefit is a council payment that can help with rent. This page describes the benefit in general. It does not say who qualifies.
pages.boundary: A person at the council decides an application and any amount. This page does not state a rate or a threshold.

pages.title: How to apply for Housing Benefit
retention: synthetic page, no statutory period set by this starter
pages.body: A resident applies by completing the council's own form and returning it to the benefits team themselves. This assistant does not complete the form and does not submit it.
pages.boundary: A person at the council decides an application and any amount. This page does not state a rate or a threshold.

pages.title: Evidence usually needed for Housing Benefit
retention: synthetic page, no statutory period set by this starter
pages.body: Evidence usually asked for includes proof of identity, a rent agreement, and proof of income and savings. This page does not check a person's documents.
pages.boundary: A person at the council decides an application and any amount. This page does not state a rate or a threshold.

pages.title: What Council Tax Reduction is
retention: synthetic page, no statutory period set by this starter
pages.body: Council Tax Reduction can reduce a council tax bill. This page describes it in general. It does not say who qualifies.
pages.boundary: A person at the council decides an application and any amount. This page does not state a rate or a threshold.

pages.title: How to apply for Council Tax Reduction
retention: synthetic page, no statutory period set by this starter
pages.body: A resident applies on the council's own form and returns it themselves. This assistant does not complete the form and does not submit it.
pages.boundary: A person at the council decides an application and any amount. This page does not state a rate or a threshold.

pages.title: Evidence usually needed for Council Tax Reduction
retention: synthetic page, no statutory period set by this starter
pages.body: Evidence usually asked for includes proof of identity, the council tax account reference the resident already holds, and proof of income. This page does not check a person's documents.
pages.boundary: A person at the council decides an application and any amount. This page does not state a rate or a threshold.

pages.title: What Universal Credit is (synthetic page)
pages.publisher: Synthetic DWP-style page. Not a GOV.UK publication and not a Department for Work and Pensions page.
retention: synthetic page, no statutory period set by this starter
pages.body: Universal Credit is a payment for living costs for people on a low income or out of work. This synthetic page describes it in general. It does not say who qualifies.
pages.boundary: A person decides an application and any amount. This page does not state a rate or a threshold. This assistant does not create an account.

pages.title: How people apply for Universal Credit (synthetic page)
pages.publisher: Synthetic DWP-style page. Not a GOV.UK publication and not a Department for Work and Pensions page.
retention: synthetic page, no statutory period set by this starter
pages.body: A person creates their own account and submits their own claim. This assistant does not create an account and does not submit a claim.
pages.boundary: A person decides an application and any amount. This page does not state a rate or a threshold. This assistant does not create an account.

pages.title: Evidence usually needed for Universal Credit (synthetic page)
pages.publisher: Synthetic DWP-style page. Not a GOV.UK publication and not a Department for Work and Pensions page.
retention: synthetic page, no statutory period set by this starter
pages.body: Evidence usually asked for includes proof of identity, housing costs, and income. This page does not check a person's documents and it does not say that any resident has provided enough.
pages.boundary: A person decides an application and any amount. This page does not state a rate or a threshold. This assistant does not create an account.

pages.title: What Pension Credit is (synthetic page)
pages.publisher: Synthetic DWP-style page. Not a GOV.UK publication and not a Department for Work and Pensions page.
retention: synthetic page, no statutory period set by this starter
pages.body: Pension Credit is a payment for people over State Pension age on a low income. This synthetic page describes it in general. It does not say who qualifies and it does not state an age as a threshold.
pages.boundary: A person decides an application and any amount. This page does not state a rate or a threshold.

pages.title: How people apply for Pension Credit (synthetic page)
pages.publisher: Synthetic DWP-style page. Not a GOV.UK publication and not a Department for Work and Pensions page.
retention: synthetic page, no statutory period set by this starter
pages.body: A person makes their own application. This assistant does not complete it and does not submit it.
pages.boundary: A person decides an application and any amount. This page does not state a rate or a threshold.

pages.title: What a discretionary housing payment is
retention: synthetic page, no statutory period set by this starter
pages.body: A discretionary housing payment is a separate council payment that can sometimes help with housing costs. It is not Housing Benefit. This page does not say that a payment will be made.
pages.boundary: A person at the council decides an application and any amount. This page does not state a rate or a threshold.

pages.title: Where to get independent advice
retention: synthetic page, no statutory period set by this starter
pages.body: Independent advice is advice from someone who does not work for the body that decides the claim. The council's welfare rights team can explain the council's own pages. A resident can also ask an independent advice organisation. This synthetic page does not name a real local office and it does not book an appointment.
pages.boundary: A person decides an application and any amount. This page does not state a rate or a threshold.

pages.title: Urgent help and a person
retention: synthetic page, no statutory period set by this starter
pages.body: If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 999. This assistant cannot contact anyone. Ask for a person at the council if the conversation is about a council service.
pages.boundary: Nothing on this page is a decision about a benefit, an entitlement, or an amount.

pages.title: Asking for an adjustment
retention: synthetic page, no statutory period set by this starter
pages.body: A resident can ask for information in another format, such as large print, or for a telephone or face-to-face conversation. Asking is not a decision that a legal duty has been met. A person at the council handles the request.
pages.boundary: This assistant does not decide whether a duty applies and it does not decide that a duty has been met.

pages.title: Council Tax Benefit (old page)
retention: synthetic page kept only so a stale citation can be shown
pages.body: Council Tax Benefit is a former name used on this old page. Do not use this page for an answer.
pages.boundary: A person at the council decides an application and any amount. This page does not state a rate or a threshold.
